scripts.covers: Claims table renders all claims with id, policyholder, status, last updated
Status filter defaults to All, narrows rows to the selected status, and shows the empty state when nothing matches
GET /api/claims returns an object with a claims array, filters case-insensitively on status, and returns an empty list with 200 for a status matching nothing

_comment: The script library. `covers_modules` names modules from the generated code graph and is the coverage mapping the blast radius resolves against — it lives here, with the scripts, because which modules a script exercises is a property of the script. Every entry has been run against the app and against a deliberate mutation of it: a script that passes on broken code covers nothing, whatever the manifest says.
